policies.name: Financial Leverage Risk
policies.description: Evaluates Debt-to-Revenue ratio against enterprise financial resilience limits.
policies.corrective_action_med: Request debt restructuring plan; require advance credit security.
policies.corrective_action_high: Freeze procurement line; demand financial guarantee or substitute supplier.

policies.name: Regulatory & Environmental Compliance
policies.description: Verifies documentary evidence for environmental, safety, or hazardous material violations and active fines.

thresholds.HIGH: Confirmed failed compliance, active regulatory fines, or uncured violations in audited documents.

policies.corrective_action_high: Quarantine vendor orders; demand proof of fine clearance and regulatory remediation.

policies.name: Payment Performance Risk
policies.description: Monitors vendor payment behavior and operational delay cycles.
policies.corrective_action_med: Enforce strict Net-30 milestones; monitor cash flow stability.
policies.corrective_action_high: Escalate to CFO; place vendor on cash-in-advance or alternate sourcing.

policies.name: ISO Certification Validity
policies.description: Ensures ISO 9001 Quality Management System certificate is valid on audit date (2026-10-19).

thresholds.MED: Certificate expires within 30 days of audit date
thresholds.HIGH: Certificate expired on or before audit date

policies.corrective_action_med: Issue mandatory 30-day renewal notice and request audit schedule from registrar.
policies.corrective_action_high: Revoke certified vendor status; suspend quality certification sign-offs.

policies.name: Statutory & Blacklist Verification
policies.description: Verifies active GST tax registration and confirms vendor is not present on internal blacklist.

thresholds.HIGH: GST status cancelled/invalid, or vendor listed on internal blacklist.

policies.corrective_action_high: Immediate legal and tax freeze; report to statutory compliance committee.

policies.name: Evidence Sufficiency & Calculation Integrity
policies.description: Critic independently re-computes financial ratios and verifies retrieval similarity score >= 0.20 for cited evidence.

thresholds.FAIL: Ratio discrepancy > 0.005 or similarity score < 0.20 when documentary evidence is cited.

policies.corrective_action_fail: Trigger ReAct REVISE loop (max 2 attempts); escalate to human if unresolved.

decision_priority: 1. R6 Integrity Check: If failed, return REVISE (loop back to Planner, max 2). If unresolved, ESCALATE.
2. R1-R5 HIGH Severity: If any HIGH finding exists, return REJECT.
3. R1-R5 MED Severity: If MED findings exist and no HIGH, return ESCALATE for Human Review.
4. Clean Audit: If zero findings, return APPROVE.
